source.basis: Google Patents BigQuery public dataset, CPC-first 10-year priority-date candidate collection
source.note: CPC-prefix candidates, not text-validated aerospace patents. Family metrics use distinct nonzero family_id, with missing IDs counted separately by publication. Office/field/year memberships overlap. Applicant names retain source spelling (first five names per publication in collection SQL); CPC counts are row-prefix occurrences (first twenty source codes), not family shares.
